phase_prompt.summary: Wosayaleel in his fully integrated ancient‑tech form, ready for confrontation.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Wosayaleel, a towering figure draped in basalt woven robes, his skin bearing faint bio‑luminescent glyphs that pulse with an inner light. An obsidian visor covers his eyes, integrated with crystalline ocular sensors that scan the environment. Heavy leather armor plates, etched with ancient Ethiopian and Egyptian motifs, are fused to his shoulders and chest, forming a protective lattice that channels energy through embedded crystal conduits. The air around him shimmers with faint, iridescent mist, hinting at the incomprehensible technology he wields.
